answers.core:
This feature is a universal upgrade to the scene tree functionality, and is never useless to users, even if they choose not to use it. 

Given that this has been an ongoing problem for 5 years, I would **highly** recommend that those of you who don't wish to have something like this please consider the value of Solution N.
answers.workaround: It would be often used by practically every Godot User, but if a user doesn't wish to do it from within the Scene Tree, it is still accessible in the Inspector as it always was.
